title: The prime graph odd-prime labeling conjecture
statement: Let $G$ be a graph. A graph is **prime** if it admits a prime labeling, and **odd prime** if its vertices can be injectively labeled by $1,3,\ldots,2|V(G)|-1$ so that adjacent vertices receive relatively prime labels. **Prime graph odd-prime conjecture.** Every prime graph is odd prime. No graph known to the authors is prime without being odd prime, while many graphs are known to be odd prime without being prime; the conjecture was previously introduced in the cited literature and remains open.
source_name: Holly Carter and N. Bradley Fox, “Odd Prime Graph Labelings”, arXiv:2208.08488 (2022).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.08488

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of August 2022).
